map.由每股收益与股价求盈利收益率: Compute earnings yield from EPS and share price
map.输入每股收益 EPS 与股价 P，求盈利收益率。: Enter earnings per share (EPS) and share price (P) to compute the earnings yield.
map.📖 查看「由每股收益与股价求盈利收益率 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Compute earnings yield from EPS and share price User Guide"
map.市盈率的倒数。: The reciprocal of the P/E ratio.
map.的倒数，衡量每元市价对应的盈利。: reciprocal, measuring earnings per unit of market price.
map.价值股筛选（高 E/P 相对便宜）。: Value-stock screening (high E/P is relatively cheap).
map.盈利收益率 = 1/PE = 1/20 = 5%。即每 100 元市值对应 5: Earnings yield = 1/PE = 1/20 = 5%. That is, every 100 yuan of market cap corresponds to 5 yuan of annualized earnings.
map.E/P = 1/15 ≈ 6.67%。比 PE=20 更具盈利性价比（同样价格赚: E/P = 1/15 ≈ 6.67%. More earnings-attractive than PE=20 (same price earns more).
map.盈利收益率和债券收益率比什么？: What do earnings yield and bond yield compare?
map.粗略比较股票 E/P 与无风险/信用债收益率，判断股债相对便宜。但盈利波动大、非: Roughly compare a stock's E/P with risk-free/credit-bond yields to judge whether stocks or bonds are relatively cheap. But earnings are volatile and not fixed coupons, so it is only a reference.
map.周期股 PE 失真时 E/P 也失真？: When a cyclical stock's PE is distorted, is its E/P also distorted?
map.是。周期顶点盈利高、E/P 虚高、PE 虚低，需用正常化盈利（周期平均）修正。: Yes. At a cyclical peak earnings are high, E/P is falsely high and PE falsely low; normalize earnings (cyclical average) to correct it.
